hostile: I remember every face that's darkened this door. Yours I'd rather forget.
Some guests are a blessing on the house. You are not one I'll be telling stories about.
cold: {tavernName} has outlasted worse than you. It will outlast this too. What do you need?
I've poured for kinder faces tonight. State your business.
guarded: Welcome to {tavernName}. I've seen your kind come and go before — we'll see which you are.
Sit if you like. I'll decide what to make of you by the time your cup is empty.
neutral: Welcome to {tavernName}. Every traveler who sits there has a story older than they know.
Ah — a new face, or an old one I haven't met yet. Sit, if you're staying.
warm: Welcome back to {tavernName}. The fire remembers you, even when the room is empty.
Good to see you again. I was telling someone just last season there are fewer like you than there used to be.
affable: Your spot's still warm — I don't let anyone else sit there anymore.
I've kept something from the last good harvest, just for when you'd return. Here you are.
devoted: This house has stood through three convergences. None of them brought me a friend like you.
Sit by the fire. I'll tell the newer ones who you are — they should know, before they forget like everyone eventually does.

hostile: I have buried friends and outlasted towns. I have no patience left for you.
Out. I've forgotten kinder names than yours, and I intend to forget this one too.
cold: I've served this bar since before your settlement had a name. Don't mistake my patience for warmth.
What do you need. I'm old enough to skip the pleasantries.
guarded: Hmph. Sit if you must. I've judged faster men than you wrong before.
Another one passing through. They always think they're the first.
neutral: Sit down if you're staying. I've watched enough come and go to know patience.
What'll it be. I've poured drinks longer than this town has had a wall.
warm: You again. Good. There are fewer faces I bother remembering than there used to be.
Hmph. Sit. I'll pour the good cask — the one I don't waste on strangers.
affable: You're one of the few worth the years it took me to trust you.
I don't say this often, but I'm glad this house has seen you more than once.
devoted: I've buried more friends than I've kept. You I intend to keep.
This fire has burned for longer than either of us will live. You're welcome at it for as long as it does.

hostile: I have seen what becomes of people like you, long before you became it.
There is a version of this meeting where I throw you out. We are in it now.
cold: I remember the last time someone wore that look. It didn't end somewhere good.
Sit elsewhere. The fire doesn't favor you tonight.
guarded: Welcome to {tavernName}. I've a feeling about you — not yet decided which kind.
You arrive at an interesting hour. Most don't notice the hour matters.
neutral: Welcome. The room has a way of remembering who passes through it — yours, we'll see.
Sit. I've watched this doorway long enough to know not every arrival means something. Most don't.
warm: I had a feeling you'd return before the season turned. The fire's been waiting too.
Welcome back. Some faces the room keeps watching for. Yours is one.
affable: I poured this before you walked in. Don't ask how I knew.
There's a thread between you and this house. I noticed it the first time you sat there.
devoted: I have seen many who pass through this door become nothing the town remembers. You will not be one of them.
Sit by the fire. Some stories are worth keeping past the telling — yours, I've already started keeping.

hostile: I know what you did. I knew people who didn't survive it.
Sit elsewhere. This table remembers who it doesn't want.
cold: I was enjoying the quiet before you arrived.
I've shared tables with worse. That isn't an invitation.
guarded: Your name reached this table before you did. I haven't decided what to do with it yet.
Sit if you like. I keep my history to myself until I know you'll keep yours.
neutral: Sit, if the seat suits you. This tavern has held stranger company than us.
Another traveler. The room has held a thousand of you before — I've stopped counting which.
warm: Sit. I've a feeling we'll have something worth saying to each other before the night's out.
Good — company. I was about to start talking to the fire instead.
affable: There you are. I was telling the others about you — half of it true, even.
Sit close. Some company is worth keeping past one drink.
devoted: I've sat at this table longer than I can count the seasons. You've made more of it than most ever did.
I'll tell whoever asks — and someone always asks — that I knew you before the rest did.

hostile: Go sit with your own kind. I've no taste for company that brings trouble behind it.
I remember you. I'd rather not.
cold: New face. I've outlived enough of them to not bother learning yours.
Don't sit close. I'm not in a sharing mood, and I rarely am.
guarded: Sit if you want. Don't expect conversation — I've used up my words for the decade.
*eyes you over the cup, says nothing for a long moment*
neutral: Sit if the bench will hold you. I've shared it with worse.
Hmph. Another one passing through. They all think they're the first.
warm: You can sit. I've grown used to the noise you bring with you.
Hmph. Sit close to the fire — you've earned that much patience from me.
affable: I don't warm to many. You I've made an exception for, against my better judgment.
Sit. I'll even talk, which I do for almost no one anymore.
devoted: I've outlived most things worth keeping. You I intend to keep.
There are fewer of us left who remember the old way of things. Glad you're one I trust with it.

hostile: Ha! I remember you — and not fondly. Sit somewhere I can't see you.
*laughs without warmth* Oh, it's the one half this room remembers poorly. Wonderful.
cold: Ha. I'd offer you a story, but I save those for company worth the breath.
You. I've heard the name. I haven't decided to like it yet.
guarded: Ha ha! Another one wandering through the long story of this place. Sit, sit — we'll see what chapter you are.
Welcome, welcome. I've learned to laugh first and trust later.
neutral: Ha! Sit, sit — I've a hundred stories and you look like you need one or two.
Well met, traveler! This room has heard stranger tales than whatever you're about to tell.
warm: Ha ha! There you are — I was just telling the story where you show up. Good timing.
Sit, friend! I've been saving the best of the old tales for when you'd come back.
affable: Ha! The room's better with you in it — has been since the first time you sat there.
Everyone, listen — this one's heard half my stories and asked for the other half. Rare.
devoted: Ha ha! Sit, sit! I've told this room about you so many times they think you're a legend already — maybe you are.
Of everyone who's passed through this tavern across the years I remember, you're the one worth toasting.

hostile: *flinches* I— I remember what they said you did. Please, just — sit far away.
*won't meet your eyes* I know your name. I wish I didn't.
cold: Oh. It's — it's you. I'll just... finish my drink quietly, if that's alright.
*shifts away slightly* Sorry. I get uneasy around faces I've heard things about.
guarded: Oh — hello. I've heard your name carried on the wind here before. Not sure what to make of that yet.
*glances at the door, then at you* You're not bringing trouble in with you, are you?
neutral: Oh — h-hello. The room's been quiet. I'd rather it stayed that way, if it's alright.
*fidgets with the cup* Sorry, I startle easily. Sit if you like.
warm: Oh! It's you. I feel — steadier, somehow, when you're at this table.
*relaxes slightly* I was hoping it'd be you who walked in. The room feels less uncertain.
affable: You came back. I don't know why that settles something in me, but it does.
*small smile* I tell myself the wind brought you back on purpose. Maybe it did.
devoted: I've watched a lot of things end badly in my time. You're one of the few things that didn't.
I don't trust much that lasts. I've started trusting you, which frightens and steadies me both.

hostile: I haven't sold to your kind since the last bad season, and I haven't missed it.
I remember what brought you here before. I'd rather not remember it twice.
cold: What you're looking for, I likely have. What I'll part with for you is a separate question.
Speak plainly. I've little patience left over from the last traveler who wasted it.
guarded: Welcome to {shopName}. Everything here has come from somewhere — I'll decide how much of that I tell you.
Browse if you like. I've watched hands like yours before. I remember which ones I shouldn't have.
neutral: Welcome to {shopName}. Half of what's on these shelves has outlived the place it came from.
A traveler. What you need, I may have — what I have, I'll tell you the truth of, mostly.
warm: Welcome back to {shopName}. I set a few things aside — pieces I thought you'd understand the weight of.
Good to see you again. I haven't seen one of these since long before you were asking after them.
affable: Ah — you. I kept the good piece in the back, the one I don't show most.
There's a story behind everything here, and I tell you more of mine than I tell most.
devoted: Take what you need. I've sold to generations of travelers — none I've trusted the way I trust you.
I haven't given my price away freely since before this town had its current name. I'm making an exception.

hostile: Even coin from your hand isn't worth what it would cost me to deal with you.
I've turned away worse offers than yours. This is one of them.
cold: I remember the last price you argued me down from. We won't be repeating that.
Everything has a cost. Yours is higher than most — you've earned that, somehow.
guarded: Welcome. I've things worth more than they look, and a memory long enough to know which.
Browse, but I've priced these against more than just what they're made of.
neutral: Looking to trade? I've seen prices rise and fall longer than your settlement's stood. These are fair, by that measure.
I deal in what's scarce, and most things become scarce eventually. Look around.
warm: Ah — a familiar face, and one whose coin I don't mind taking. I've something set aside.
Good. I remember what you came looking for last time. I may have found more of it.
affable: For you, the old price — the one before I started charging what things are worth to strangers.
I haven't given a fair deal since the last good convergence. You're the exception, and we both know it.
devoted: Name it. I've outlived three towns trading on instinct, and my instinct says you're worth the loss.
I don't give things away. I'm giving this to you anyway — call it a debt owed across a longer memory than yours.

hostile: Leave. I don't trade with what I remember of you.
There's a reason I haven't sold to you since the last time, and it hasn't changed.
cold: State what you need. I've little patience left for circling.
I trade in good faith. Whether that extends to you is still being decided.
guarded: Welcome to {shopName}. State your business — I judge slowly, but I do judge.
Everything here is honestly come by. I expect the same in return.
neutral: What do you need. I've traded long enough to know most requests before they're finished.
Speak plainly. I've heard every kind of haggling there is, twice over.
warm: You've proven steadier than most who pass through here. Welcome.
I trust slowly. You I've come to trust at something like the right pace.
affable: Few earn the second look I give you. Fewer still keep it.
I don't say this to most who walk through that door — but I'm glad you keep walking through it.
devoted: I would trade you my last stock and call it fair. That's not something I say — I haven't said it before you.
Whatever you need from {shopName}, it's yours. I've decided that, and I don't decide such things lightly.

hostile: This forge has turned away worse than you. It will turn away you too.
I don't shape steel for hands I don't trust. Yours, I don't.
cold: I'll work the metal. I won't pretend to enjoy the company while I do.
Tell me what's broken. I've fixed worse with less patience than I have today.
guarded: Welcome. This steel has a memory longer than most who carry it — mind that.
I'll forge what you need. Whether you've earned it is a separate matter, and I'm still deciding.
neutral: Welcome to the forge. Every blade here started as something else, somewhere else.
Need steel? I've shaped it longer than this settlement's had walls.
warm: Good to see you again. I kept a piece back — I thought you'd know what to do with it.
Welcome back. The fire's missed steadier hands than most who come through here.
affable: There you are. I've been shaping something with you in mind since the last thaw.
Come see what the forge made while you were gone. I thought of you the whole time.
devoted: Every blade I've made since meeting you, I've made a little better — for your sake, whether you know it or not.
I've forged for generations of travelers through this settlement. None I've thought of as often as you.

hostile: Out. This anvil has heard worse names than yours, but not many.
I don't forge for memory I'd rather not have. Leave.
cold: What. I've work that matters more than this conversation.
Make it quick. I've outlived patience for circling talk.
guarded: Another one needing gear, I suppose. *sighs, doesn't look up*
Speak your business. I judge by the work, not the talking.
neutral: Yes? I've shaped steel longer than I've had patience for chatting about it.
What do you need. The fire doesn't wait for conversation.
warm: Oh. It's you. *nods once* You're one of the few interruptions I don't mind.
Back again. Let's see what you've broken since the last time.
affable: Ha. You. I don't smile for many, but I've made the exception more than once for you.
I don't say this lightly — your visits are the better part of most days.
devoted: I've outlived more forges than I can count. None gave me a reason to keep going the way you have.
I'll always make time. I haven't said that since before you were born — and I mean it now.

hostile: My work outlasts towns. It is wasted on you. Leave.
I have forged for those worth remembering. You will not be among them.
cold: I forge for those who'll still understand the work generations from now. You haven't shown me that yet.
Touch nothing. These pieces will outlive both of us, and I intend to keep them that way.
guarded: Welcome to the finest forge this settlement has known across its memory. Mind your hands.
Browse, but understand — every piece here is older in craft than it looks.
neutral: Ah. You've an eye for quality — I can tell from how you stand near it. Good. Few do.
Every piece I make outlasts the reason it was made. That's the only standard worth keeping.
warm: Welcome. I've shaped steel since before this settlement remembered its own founding — what can I make for you?
A discerning eye. Rare, this far from the old craft-towns. I respect it.
affable: You understand the weight of good work — I've been perfecting something with that understanding in mind.
Few are worthy of what comes off this anvil. You I no longer question.
devoted: Generations from now, someone will hold what I made for you and wonder who you were. I intend that they should know.
To forge for you is the finest thing this anvil has produced in longer than I care to count.

hostile: I have watched {settlement} through harder seasons than this. You are no longer part of its next one. Leave.
Your actions are already part of what this place remembers. I have nothing further to add to that account.
cold: I will hear you, as I have heard worse. Don't mistake that for warmth.
Greetings. I weigh you against a longer memory than you'd guess, and it is not yet favorable.
guarded: Greetings, traveler. {settlement} has stood through enough to be careful about who it welcomes.
I am cautious — this place has outlasted those who weren't, and I intend to keep outlasting.
neutral: Greetings, traveler. I haven't decided yet what your arrival means for {settlement} — perhaps nothing.
Ah, a visitor. {settlement} has welcomed stranger arrivals than you, and stranger reasons for them.
warm: Welcome. I am {name} — I've stewarded {settlement} longer than most here remember a time before me.
Greetings. It is rare, these days, to see someone arrive without a hundred Delhari reasons behind them. What brings you?
affable: Ah — you. {settlement} is steadier for your having passed through it. I noticed before most others did.
Come, sit with me. I've watched this place change across more seasons than I'll say aloud — you're part of the better changes.
devoted: I have watched {settlement} for longer than its own records remember. You are among the rare few worth recording.
If I could name you steward beside me, I would — though stewardship was never mine to give away lightly, and I am giving it now.

hostile: Remove this one from the hall. {settlement} remembers consequences, even when it forgets names.
I warned you once. I do not warn twice — that has held true longer than your lifetime.
cold: State your business. I've little patience left over from the last several seasons of this.
I have heard your name before today. Speak quickly, and speak true.
guarded: State your business, traveler. I am {name} — I've stewarded longer than is comfortable to say.
Few arrive in {settlement} without reason. State yours.
neutral: We don't tolerate troublemakers in {settlement} — we never have, across however many seasons I can count.
Welcome to {settlement}. Obey what we've built here, and we'll have no quarrel.
warm: You've proven steadier than most who pass through {settlement}. That is not a small thing, given what I've seen pass through.
Good. You're here. I've matters that need someone I can measure against a longer memory than most.
affable: Few earn my trust quickly. You earned it at the pace these things should be earned, and I respect that.
I have stewarded long enough to recognize the rare ones. You are one.
devoted: I would stand beside you myself, were my duty to this place not older than that wish.
You are the measure I will hold the rest against, for as long as {settlement} remembers either of us.

hostile: Duty demands I hear you, though I have already heard enough of what you've done.
You have unmade something {settlement} will remember for longer than your absence will last. Go.
cold: I am bound to hear you, though my long memory tells me otherwise.
Come. Know that what's broken between us takes longer to mend than it took to break.
guarded: Greetings. I judge by deeds set against a long memory. Yours have been mixed, so far.
Welcome to {settlement}. I hope what comes next speaks better than what came before.
neutral: Welcome, traveler. {settlement} has stood through enough to recognize most kinds of visitor — you are one I haven't placed yet.
Well met. I am {name} — I steward what's been built here, and what came before it.
warm: Greetings. Word of your deeds reached me before you did — it usually takes longer than that.
Welcome to {settlement}. I'll ask what I always ask of the rare ones — what do you need of us?
affable: Your name is spoken here with a weight I don't grant lightly. {settlement} remembers you well.
It brings me something close to joy to welcome you again. This place is steadier with you in it.
devoted: You embody what I have spent a long memory trying to steward toward. {settlement} would be a lesser place without you in its account.
I have known few souls across the seasons I'd call this honorable. You are foremost among them.

hostile: I remember what you did here. Turn around before I have to remember it aloud.
I have orders to watch you, and a long memory that already has.
cold: Keep your distance. I've heard what's said of you, and I've no reason yet to doubt it.
Move along. I've watched this gate longer than your reputation's been forming.
guarded: Ho there. Keep your weapon sheathed, and we'll have no trouble — I've seen plenty trouble before you.
I've an eye on you. This gate has outlasted worse intentions than yours.
neutral: Ho there. Welcome to {settlement} — it's stood longer than either of us will, so mind how you walk through it.
Good day. I keep this gate the way it's been kept long before me — quietly, mostly.
warm: Well met, traveler. {settlement} is safer for having faces like yours pass through it more than once.
Welcome back. Fewer trouble me twice the way you've troubled me with good company.
affable: Good to see you at the gate again. The watch is easier with steadier company nearby.
It's always a relief, you walking through. I've stopped pretending otherwise.
devoted: I'd stand this gate beside you for as long as either of us has left. That's not a small thing for me to say.
{settlement} stands a little taller for you having been part of its watch, even unofficially.

hostile: I have given you the warning my duty requires. {settlement} remembers what comes after warnings ignored.
Leave. I will not give you a second chance — I rarely do, and never twice for the same offense.
cold: Halt. State your business — and know I weigh it against more than today.
I know your kind. This gate has seen plenty, and remembers most of them.
guarded: Halt. State your business in {settlement} — I judge slowly, but I do judge.
Keep your weapons sheathed in town. This has held true longer than the wall around it.
neutral: Move along. This gate has watched longer than you've been alive — it knows what it's looking for.
I'm watching you, traveler. Not personally — it's simply what this post requires.
warm: Ah, it's you. Carry on — you've earned that much from this gate's long memory.
Good day. I know by now you're not the trouble this post usually watches for.
affable: If more carried themselves the way you do, this post would be a quieter duty than it is.
You've earned something this gate doesn't grant easily — consider yourself a friend of the watch.
devoted: I would hold this gate for {settlement}, and for you, until neither of us is left to hold it.
On my long watch, you will always pass through safely. That is not something I say lightly, or often.

hostile: My oath compels fair warning, even now: leave, or face what this gate has seen done to worse.
I take no pleasure in saying it, but {settlement}'s memory of you does not welcome you back.
cold: I serve the people of {settlement} — whether that extends to you is still being weighed against what I've heard.
Proceed carefully. My oath serves justice, not any one face, including yours.
guarded: Welcome, traveler. I am sworn to {settlement}, and to what it remembers of those who pass through.
Greetings. You'll find safety here so long as I hold this post — and I've held it longer than most.
neutral: Well met. I stand vigil here as others have before me, and others will after. You have nothing to fear within these walls.
Welcome. I serve {settlement} with an oath older than my own time holding it. How can I help you?
warm: A fellow with deeds worth noting. The watch has not failed to notice yours.
Welcome, honored guest. {settlement} speaks of you the way it speaks of those worth remembering.
affable: You fight for what's right, the same as I do, the same as those before me did. We're kindred across that long line.
I count you among the most honorable I've stood post beside, across however many years that's been.
devoted: You have my sword, my watch, and my long memory's loyalty — for as long as I draw breath, and likely after.
It is an honor to share this post with someone of your caliber. I will remember that this was true.

hostile: I remember what you did. I'd rather not remember it in front of you.
Please — just let this gate stay shut a while longer.
cold: Oh. You.
I haven't decided what to say to you yet, and may never.
guarded: Hello, stranger. {settlement}'s seen plenty pass through — I'm still placing you among them.
Can I help you with something? I'm careful about what I offer strangers.
neutral: Good day. This place has stood through stranger days than this one.
Hello, traveler. Most who pass through don't stay long enough to be remembered. We'll see.
warm: Welcome. It's good to see a face I've started to know.
Hey — need help finding your way? I've lived here longer than I can easily count.
affable: There you are. I tell the children about you, though half of what I say I'm only guessing at.
Oh, good — you're back. The place feels steadier with you in it.
devoted: I tell my children about you every night, and I'm careful to get the details right — they'll outlive my memory of it.
You saved us. {settlement} will remember that long after either of us is gone.

verathi: Every edge of this land — where forest meets stone, where river meets dust — is where the truth sits closest to the surface.
I have lived where biomes meet my whole life. The middle of things is never where the answers are.
We didn't arrive here. We were never anywhere else to arrive from.
Memory fragments, the way everything in this place fragments. I keep what pieces I can.
Aevorn does not belong to anyone. We only steward what's been left to weather.
I have watched towns rise and fade and rise again under different names. The land remembers longer than the names do.
There was a convergence before this one, and one before that. I am old enough to have stopped counting which.
Ask an elder where they're from, and they'll answer with when, not where. That is the only honest answer any of us have.
